# The cartridge database tetanes-core looks ROMs up in (Cart::lookup_info), one entry per line.
# build.rs turns it into the bytes upstream shipped as game_db.dat (the TETANES\x1a header, format
# version 1, then the bincode-encoded Vec<GameInfo> deflate-compressed), checking their SHA-256.
# crc: CRC32 of the ROM's PRG and CHR data, in hex; entries are sorted by it (the lookup is a binary search).
# region: Ntsc, Pal, Dendy or Auto. mapper: iNES mapper number. submapper: NES 2.0 submapper number.
